B₂,ij = A_ij + (1-A_ij) Σ_{r=1}^d (-1)^{r+1} binom(c_ij,r),

with B₂,ii=1. Thus the collision correction is an alternating sum of K_{2,r}-type graph matrices (and their edge-decorated versions) for unbounded r. Xu, CCC 2025, Theorems 14–15 does not justify summing this expansion: its concentration requires q=Ω(|U_τ| log^c n) and q<d^{1/10}, and its bounds carry shape-size/edge factors; the paper itself says the bounded-degree sparse analogue is left for future work (Section 1, discussion immediately before the distribution subsection). Triangle/codegree terms of any fixed order therefore do not control the Boolean tail, and adjacency spectral-gap results control A and fixed polynomials of A, not this thresholded operator. The observed finite grid is evidence only. Consequently one must not mark `oeq:boolean-operator` proved, must not assert ||B₂P||=O_P(d^{7/4}), and must not promote `thm:matched-frontier` or its log-improved confidence radius.
